registration_kind: pre-fit; written after data/feature audit but before any H57 model fit or spatial-holdout score

geodawn_rad_u8.tif.provenance: SHA/size-pinned owner-mirror derivative of the official USGS GeoDAWN release; raw-to-derivative chain not organizer-authenticated

geodawn_extensions_u8.tif.provenance: SHA/size-pinned owner-mirror derivative of the official USGS GeoDAWN release; raw-to-derivative chain not organizer-authenticated

lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif.provenance: SHA/size-pinned owner-mirror derivative; official USGS 3DEP is source context, not direct authentication of these derived bytes

primary_hypothesis: H57-1: corrected potential-field/subsurface View A and surface/radiometric/LiDAR View B may find cover-hidden range-front discontinuities through whole-component buffered one-round co-training; enabled only if the registered OOF error gate passes
ranked_unrun_alternatives: H57-3: conductivity-edge termination at gravity/RTP T-junctions
H57-4: event-level USGS ComCat lineaments aligned with broad structural edges

views.source: src/gems55/radlayers.py; the corrected lists below are frozen
views.band6_routing: GeoDAWN total count; View B only; must not be used as magnetic/tilt input to A
model_features_not_used: Prior submission TIFF values or masks
SGMC/Quaternary-fault external traces as positive labels

feature_construction.core_builder: gems52.features.build; output arrays are used only through the frozen radlayers view lists
feature_construction.stack_encoding: per-channel linear min-max mapping to uint8 0..255 over the all-19-band valid footprint using gems52.cotrain.rank_u8 (legacy-named helper; this is not an empirical CDF rank); NaN values map to zero; label-free/transductive, no evaluation labels or label statistics
feature_construction.valid_domain: finite intersection of all 19 training_features.tif bands

fold_protocol.assignment: four fixed contiguous quadrants; whole original 8-connected catalogue components assigned by majority quadrant
fold_protocol.evaluation_region: eligible pixels in the held quadrant plus support around tails of held components
leakage_invariants: nearest training pixel is at least 80 pixels from evaluation region
zero evaluation pixels in pseudo-label rows
fold_protocol.negative_class: catalogue-zero proxy only; not verified geological absence
fold_protocol.sampling: all eligible training positives and a deterministic without-replacement sample from training pixels outside a 3-pixel dilation of the catalogue

independence_gate.negative_observations: finite held-out OOF predictions in 50x50 blocks outside a 3-pixel catalogue collar
independence_gate.threshold_for_fpr: each view's 99th percentile on the fold's training-unlabelled domain
independence_gate.decision: all two metrics must be defined and have absolute Pearson/Spearman <0.60 for each fold and pooled; otherwise disable exchange
independence_gate.undefined_or_missing: fail closed; do not impute or switch to pixel correlation

pseudo_label_exchange.forbidden: all labelled positives and 3-pixel collar, sampled labelled rows, non-training cells, and any evaluation pixel
pseudo_label_exchange.if_gate_fails: no pseudo labels are created; co-training primary is not fit or scored; use B-only research fallback
pseudo_label_exchange.activation_gate: Every one of the four outer folds must yield at least one eligible whole segment from A to B and at least one from B to A before any round-1 model is fit or scored; otherwise disable exchange globally and use the registered B-only research fallback.

primary_field.a_only: pA >= training-unlabelled q99(A) AND q40(B) <= pB <= q80(B)
primary_field.b_only: pB >= training-unlabelled q99(B) AND q40(A) <= pA <= q80(A)
primary_field.concordant: pA >= training-unlabelled q99(A) AND pB >= training-unlabelled q99(B)
primary_field.depth_rank: label-free empirical rank of training_features.tif band 15 over the all-19-band valid footprint
primary_field.threshold_source: training-unlabelled pixels only; relative confidence, not calibrated probability
primary_field.threshold_reuse: Compute q40/q80/q99 from round-0 supervised model scores on training&valid&catalogue-zero pixels; reuse unchanged for the round-0 control and round-1 candidate, with no post-exchange re-estimation.
primary_field.composition: Initialize every prediction-region cell to 0.5*pA+0.5*pB; replace concordant cells with min(pA,pB), A-only cells with pA*(0.35+0.40*depth_rank), and B-only cells with 0.25*pB. Priority for degenerate tied thresholds: concordant, then A-only, then B-only.

placement.pool_rule: min(400000, max(16*per_fold_budget, 10000)); same for every arm, matching the prior 80-pixel validation runner

primary_comparator.same_run: strongest among view_A, corrected view_B, early_fusion, max_AB_union_control, and round0 disagreement control

historical_best_comparable.note: historical local catalogue-holdout proxy; H55 baseline view routing was not radiometrically corrected, so this is a conservative reference floor, not organizer truth

primary_comparator.paired_fold_rule: Choose the one same-run control with highest mean DTI across all four folds; compute paired differences against that fixed control in every fold.

slot_gate.on_any_failure: research-only; do not spend a weekly submission slot
slot_gate.paired_fold_control_selection: the single strongest same-run control by four-fold mean DTI, fixed for all paired differences
slot_gate.support_novelty_fraction: reported as a diagnostic only, not a promotion gate; dense historical diagnostic rasters may saturate the prior union
slot_gate.decoded_uniqueness_definition: candidate float32 grid is not exactly equal to any supplied aligned prior after canonical NaN/sentinel normalization; report both literal prior-union equality and per-prior comparisons
slot_gate.literal_union_definition: candidate is not the exact support union of all supplied priors and is not the same-run union of matched-budget View-A and View-B emissions

research_artifact.fallback_if_independence_fails: corrected view_B only; label it single-view, not co-training
research_artifact.submission_latest_pointer: do not point the competitive LATEST marker at a failed-gate H57 artifact

provenance_caveats: Core/external rasters are SHA/size-pinned owner mirrors, not organizer-authenticated downloads.
Catalogue-zero proxy cells may contain unknown faults.
Original connected components are spatial proxies, not authenticated fault segment identifiers.
A passing local catalogue-holdout metric is not validation on organizer-hidden new-fault labels.
Local format and decoded-pattern checks are not organizer upload acceptance.

arms_definition.view_A: round-0 corrected View A probability field
arms_definition.view_B_corrected: round-0 corrected View B probability field
arms_definition.early_fusion: round-0 HistGradientBoostingClassifier fitted on concatenated corrected A+B features using the same rows and weights
arms_definition.max_AB_union_control: pixelwise maximum of round-0 A and B probabilities
arms_definition.round0_disagreement_no_exchange: registered primary-field composition using round-0 A/B probabilities and training-only thresholds
arms_definition.cotrain_disagreement_aonly_when_gate_pas: registered primary-field composition using round-1 A/B probabilities after bilateral whole-component exchange
arms_definition.matched_random: uniform without-replacement sample from the identical allowed set at the matched per-fold budget
